notes: Official score.py uses the third TSV column (reference rare words) to partition B-WER/U-WER, not the fourth full prompt/distractor list.
Official alignment uses insertion/deletion cost 3, substitution cost 4; its reported counts may differ from unit-cost Levenshtein alignment.
Pilot is raw no-context ASR only. No hotwords fed to model. No correction benefit can be inferred from this baseline.

Hypothesis normalization: NFKC + casefold, curly apostrophes to ASCII, Unicode alphanumerics/whitespace/apostrophes retained, other punctuation separated. No spelling-number conversion or fillers removal.
